The federal donation credit has two tiers. The first two hundred dollars gets fourteen point five percent. Every dollar above that gets twenty-nine.
Claimed separately, each of them stays in the low tier. Twenty-nine dollars each. Fifty-eight in total.
But a couple can put both receipts on one return. Four hundred dollars: the first two hundred at the low rate, the rest at twenty-nine percent. Eighty-seven dollars.
The twist: a small receipt doesn't have to be used this year. You can carry donations forward up to five years, and claim them together once you pass two hundred.
So pool your receipts before you file.
